rationale: The workflow is a docs build triggered on pull_request (opened/synchronize) for docs/**. Each new push to a PR supersedes the previous check for that PR, so the stale in-progress run can be canceled when a newer revision arrives. This matches P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (cancel superseded runs): preconditions are met because runs represent the same workflow and PR and a newer revision supersedes older checks; contraindications are avoided because this is a docs build, not release/deployment work, and the concurrency group is scoped by head_ref so distinct branches/PRs are isolated. Dependency caching already exists via setup-node cache:pnpm, so no redundant cache change is needed. Timeout-based patterns (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT) are not supported here because the repository has no completed CI runs, so the representative-history precondition cannot be verified and a custom timeout risks false timeouts on valid slow runs. The change preserves all existing steps and required coverage, adds no permissions, secrets, publishing/deployment operations, or new network access.
